items.detail: Alkali aur base dono hi “OH‑” dene wale substances hote hain, lekin unka use thoda alag hota hai. **Base** – koi bhi aisa material jo metal ke saath react karke hydrogen gas (H₂) de, jaise NaOH jab Zn se react karta hai (Zn + NaOH → H₂ + …)

ch2: why is sodium hydrogencarbonate used to treat acidity
